history.name: The authoring rules on demand
history.description: The command ledger rules prints the full rules for writing the ledger: what each field means, where the bar for an entry sits, and how to record a change, a rename or a removal. The project's tone is printed inside it, and a RULES.md in the ledger directory replaces the packaged text with your own house conventions.
history.dev_notes: assets/RULES.md with a {style} placeholder; a project copy at .ledger/RULES.md wins. src/commands/read.mjs cmdRules.
